lastCompletedStory.title: Build-time Dockerfile: pre-create bun-owned /home/bun/.claude and install jq

nextStoryContext: US-001 added jq to apt-get install and mkdir -p /home/bun/.claude before chown -R in the re-home block. FRESH named volumes will inherit bun ownership from the image dir on first mount. EXISTING volumes (stale root-owned) still need the runtime chown self-heal from US-003. No TS source was touched; no embed-vendor step needed.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: empty named volume inherits image directory contents and ownership on first mount. Non-empty volumes are NOT overwritten (pre-existing content takes precedence). mkdir before chown is the correct pattern for fresh-volume bun-ownership inheritance.
